# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

VLC-Whisper is currently in early development. Security fixes are provided for the latest released version.

| Version        | Supported |
| -------------- | --------- |
| Latest release | Yes       |
| Older releases | No        |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

Instead, use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting feature to report a vulnerability privately to the maintainer.

When reporting a vulnerability, please include, where applicable:

- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact
- Steps to reproduce the issue
- The affected VLC-Whisper version
- Relevant operating system and VLC version
- Any suggested mitigation or fix

Please avoid including sensitive information in public issues or discussions.

Security reports will be reviewed as time permits. Confirmed vulnerabilities will be addressed and disclosed through an appropriate security update or GitHub Security Advisory.
